routes.name: Industrial landing
routes.goal: Communicate capability by product class and sourcing workflow
routes.sections: Technical split hero; categories rail; production process strip; material grade quick selector; sample industrial applications; RFQ steps
routes.actions: Category tile opens filtered catalog; product selector updates spec quickview
routes.acceptance: First fold communicates B2B procurement value

routes.name: Engineering catalog
routes.sections: Search by code/name; category, grade, dimension, finish filters; price disclosure as request quote; card/table switch; sort
routes.actions: Intersection filters; URL persistence; table accessible and horizontally scroll contained

routes.name: SKU dossier
routes.sections: Product photo set; unique identifier; dimensional drawings; gauge, material, finish; packing; lead-time example caveat; use cases; downloads; related SKUs
routes.actions: Variant/grade selection changes exact specs; add correct variant and MOQ to RFQ
routes.acceptance: SKU detail matches quote basket and downloaded sheet

routes.name: Spec comparison
routes.sections: 3-column comparison with grouped attributes and missing values marked
routes.actions: Add/remove SKU; compare URLs; export print view
routes.acceptance: Each column matches selected SKU, no mismatched units

routes.name: Quotation basket
routes.sections: Line items, grades, quantities and units, MOQ messaging, notes and region, validation, review summary
routes.actions: Update remove items, save draft, submit SQLite, produce demonstrative receipt
routes.acceptance: Duplicate SKU merges only when variant identical

routes.name: Applications
routes.goal: Connect specification to real buying context
routes.sections: Construction, packaging, machinery, architectural and HVAC example use cases
routes.actions: Filter products by use case and link to matching detail

routes.name: Production capabilities
routes.sections: Material input, forming/cutting/finishing, quality checks, packing workflow, tolerance explanation
routes.actions: Interactively choose process and see compatible SKUs
routes.acceptance: No false certifications or ISO claims

routes.name: Technical library
routes.sections: Materials glossary, tolerances, finishes, FAQ and resources

routes.name: Technical article
routes.sections: Specification example tables, application checklist, download CTA, related products
routes.acceptance: Article at least 300 words each language for key resources

routes.name: Company profile
routes.sections: Manufacturing overview, process diagram, service coverage, philosophy, contact intent
routes.acceptance: No false factory capacity or export permits

routes.name: Business inquiry
routes.sections: Sales vs technical routes, RFQ link, example response steps
routes.actions: Contact demo request and actual Mavvix sales link separate

flows.name: Buyer builds export RFQ
flows.steps: Home > profiles category > filter 304 stainless and size > SKU ferro-304-40 > datasheet > add 500 m > select second SKU > RFQ basket > adjust quantity > set packaging and export destination > review > DEMO receipt > admin review queue.
flows.oracle: Qty unit correct; MOQ enforce; receipt item rows equal basket; preserved across refresh.

flows.name: Technical side-by-side selection
flows.steps: Catalog > add two compatible fasteners + one profile to compare > compare grade/diameter/finish > remove one > printable spec summary.
flows.oracle: Missing attributes shown as n/a; no false equivalence.

flows.name: Bad MOQ rejection
flows.steps: Select quantity below pack multiple > inline error > adjust to 200 > add successfully.
flows.oracle: Server rejects invalid MOQ independently of client UI.

design: Steel-blue precision instrument aesthetic. Navy #12243C / neutral #F4F6F6 / ochre #DE9E37. Clear dense tables, precise grid, macro material imagery, integrated spec sheet look, catalog-first mega-menu. Technical English typography paired to formal Arabic. No large luxury real-estate imagery.
signatureFeatures: Multi-SKU quote basket with persisted draft and quantity units/MOQ validation
Spec comparison up to 3 SKUs across consistent attributes
Technical datasheet export generated from selected local data
Export inquiry with target region, packaging unit and requested volume
seedRequirements: 24 SKUs across 5 coherent families, 4 material grades, 3 finish types, 5 use cases, 5 process records, 7 FAQ, 6 technical articles, 3 downloadable datasheets whose tables match source records.
adminRequirements: Product families, SKUs, grade/finish variants, datasheet files, technical articles and translation; RFQ requests and line item status; CSV export demo-only; publish/unpublish item. A product update must be reflected in detail, compare, search and RFQ selection.
negativeScenarios: 500 m profiles from source SKU with exact pack of 10
Product with incompatible grade missing from another SKU comparison
SKU with no image uses designed placeholder without broken icon
Quote basket survives restart in local guest session
Qty negative or non-integer pack multiplier rejected
Versioned spec sheet matches current seeded material values
